courses.title: Operating Systems

Recent offerings include Spring 2026 and 2025 (https://www.coursicle.com/mercer/courses/CSC/460/; saved .cache/text/v2c-mercer-C6-1.txt). Catalog evidence saved in .cache/text/v2c-mercer-C5-1.txt.
